```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library("foghorn")
library("allmypackages")
set.seed(0)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(rmarkdown.html_vignette.check_title = FALSE)
r = getOption("repos")
r["CRAN"] = "http://cran.us.r-project.org"
options(repos = r)
```

Here are some usage statistics for my packages.

```{r, showallpackages}
allmypackages
```

Now, for all the packages on `CRAN`, calculate their dependencies:


```{r, calculatedependencies, cache=TRUE}
(packages <- allmypackages[allmypackages$CRAN,1])

f <- function(package){
    tools::package_dependencies(
               package, which = c("Depends", "Imports", "Suggests"),
               reverse = TRUE,
               recursive = FALSE)[[1]]
}

L <- list()
for(n in packages){L <- c(L, list(f(n)))}
names(L) <- packages

dependencies <- sort(unique(unlist(L)))
```


Now summarise:

```{r}
length(dependencies)
head(dependencies)
tail(dependencies)
```

We have this many dependencies.  How distributed?
(I will work on that)

```{r warnings}
summary_cran_results(pkg = packages)
```
